name: is.memoized
title: Test whether a function is memoised

origin.description: Alias of is_memoised. The R name is is.memoized.
origin.example:
f <- function(x) x
m <- memoize(f)
cat(paste(as.integer(is.memoized(f)), as.integer(is.memoized(m))), "\n", sep = "")

translation.description: Alias of is_memoised. The R name is is.memoized.
translation.example:
from memoise import *
def f(x):
    return x

m = memoize(f)
print(int(is_memoized(f)), int(is_memoized(m)))
